recursive_provider_expansion.RightCanonical: nil ↦ True; cons A C ↦ A*A.transpose=1 ∧ RightCanonical C. This recursively expands every logical field and does not assume global run correctness.
recursive_provider_expansion.maxBond: nil r ↦ r; cons with left l ↦ max l (maxBond tail). Bounds initial, intermediate, terminal ranks.
recursive_provider_expansion.rankAt: nil remains terminal rank for every t; cons at 0 is left rank; positive t recurses.
recursive_provider_expansion.paddedAt: nil is zero; cons at 0 is paddedCore of head; positive t recurses. No isometry outside t<n.
